 1D 1W All Alpha insights Svitolina arrives steadier: 3-2 in her last five, fresh off a 3-6 6-2 6-2 win over Muchova at the Finals. Sabalenka is 2-3 and coming off a 4-6 0-6 thumping by Andreeva that prompted coach Rick Macci to say she has 'lost her identity.' Both sit 1-1 in the group, so this is effectively a semi-final decider. The dynamic: Sabalenka's first-strike power against Svitolina's counterpunching and rally tolerance. Sabalenka's ranking edge (#2 vs #6) and ceiling give her the higher gear, but her form and confidence are wobbling — Svitolina holds the slight edge.
